title: Thor Kitchen — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Thor Kitchen.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Kitchen Crafted." Thor Kitchen offers commercial-inspired ranges, refrigerators, dishwashers, and wine coolers at aggressive prices. Their 36-inch and 48-inch pro-style ranges undercut traditional brands by 40-60%. Growing in independent dealer and online channels. Quality improving with each generation.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Budget pro-style kitchen builds. Customers who want the look without the luxury price. Rental investment properties wanting an upscale look.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Thor Kitchen:

• Pro-style 6-burner range for under $2,000 — fraction of Wolf/Thermador

• Full kitchen packages available — range, fridge, DW, hood all matching

• Growing dealer support and parts availability

• Stainless construction with heavy-duty grates

• Price-per-feature ratio is unmatched in pro-style cooking
